description:
Check plain text you are writing (product description, ad or newsletter copy, terms of sale, legal notice) before publishing.

    product_description and marketing: banned or vague environmental claims ("biodegradable", "eco-friendly", "carbon neutral",
    "recycled" without a percentage); product_description also checks the GPSR manufacturer block and textile composition and origin.
    terms: legal guarantee box, consumer mediator, outdated EU ODR link, withdrawal wording, EPR unique identifier.
    legal_notice: seller identity, EPR unique identifier, mediator.
    French texts are fully supported; English texts only for environmental claims.

    Args:
        text: the text to check (up to 200,000 characters).
        text_type: what the text is.
        product_name: for a product description, the product's name (tells textiles, food and services apart).
        lang: "fr" or "en".
name: check_text
